eat too much.description: You have eaten too much and feel uncomfortably full. Your stomach is bloated and you may feel sluggish or nauseous.

boredom.description: You feel a sense of boredom and restlessness, as if you have nothing to do or no one to talk to. You may feel a lack of motivation or interest in your surroundings.
